summary: Active steel Alberta lookout whose provincial record gives a 2019 tower, 30 m tall; no history or public-access source was found.

facts.agency: Alberta wildfire staff with Agriculture and Forestry

events.note: Alberta record gives 2019 as the construction year of the present steel tower. No source found describes an earlier tower on the site.

notes_for_editor: Only Alberta's own open-data record and three Alberta pages were usable. Several searches found no history, fire, construction or public-access source for this site, so the story is short. The brief's built year (2019), 30 m height and 1,080.7 m elevation match the record; no corrections. Access is left out of facts: the brief's 'closed' level and its 'staffed March-October' and 'please don't visit uninvited' wording do not appear in any cached Alberta page, so they look like pipeline text and were not repeated. Alberta.ca says 'generally from April to October'. The layer description (footnote 4) says the data is classed Protected and should not be shown on public maps larger than 1:1,000,000 or on maps with local roads; check the coordinates on Firefinder's map against that. Pass Creek in British Columbia and the Greenview settlement are different places; no source ties either to this lookout.
